sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Ollama build of Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored — an abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with reasoning, tool-calling, and an MTP speculative-decoding head. Sixteen tags from 2-bit to 8-bit, each with the mmproj vision projector bundled in — nothing extra to fetch. Browse all ...

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3.8: Qwen3.8 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B - Cerebras Inference
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B Alibaba's 27B dense multimodal model for agentic coding, tool use, research, and long-running workflows. It accepts text and image inputs and supports configurable reasoning.

sources.title: preetpatel/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-NVFP4 NVFP4 (W4A4) quantization of orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored, an abliterated fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. ~19GB (down from ~56GB BF16) — built for single consumer Blackwell GPUs. On an RTX 5090 (32GB) it serves with 160k context and room to spare.
